description: Reproduces: keeper hold and claim accept mistyped paths, leaving the real path unprotected

steps.command: bash -c 'K=.bugpatrol/sandbox/keeper; $K plan --max-risk medium > /tmp/keeper-patrol/p.json; echo plan=$?; cat /tmp/keeper-patrol/p.json; ID=$(grep -o "\"id\":\"[a-f0-9]*\"" /tmp/keeper-patrol/p.json | head -1 | cut -d\" -f4); $K apply $ID; echo apply-noyes=$?; $K apply $ID --yes; echo apply=$?'
bash -c '.bugpatrol/sandbox/keeper apply nosuchplan --yes 2>&1 | cat; echo exit=${PIPESTATUS[0]}'

bash -c 'K=.bugpatrol/sandbox/keeper; $K undo 9c7076d7 | cat; echo undo=${PIPESTATUS[0]}; $K undo 9c7076d7 | cat; echo undo2=${PIPESTATUS[0]}; $K scan --json | head -c 600; echo; $K scan --json | python3 -I -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(type(d).__name__, list(d)[:5] if isinstance(d,dict) else len(d))"'
.bugpatrol/sandbox/tui keys k >/dev/null; .bugpatrol/sandbox/tui show | sed -n '2,3p' | cat -v; .bugpatrol/sandbox/tui keys Escape | tail -3; .bugpatrol/sandbox/tui keys x | tail -3

.bugpatrol/sandbox/tui stop; bash -c 'K=.bugpatrol/sandbox/keeper; for c in "hold /tmp/keeper-patrol/home/.worktrees/old-experiment --reason testing" "hold /tmp/keeper-patrol/home/.worktrees/old-experiment --reason again" "claim /tmp/keeper-patrol/home/nosuch" "hold /nonexistent --reason x" "scan --category worktree" "plan 0000 --max-risk low" "purge" "timer install --cron" "--version" "auto"; do echo "== $c"; $K $c 2>&1 | head -c 400; echo " exit=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"; done'
